label_provenance: Synthetic offline Information Retrieval benchmark created for algorithmic verification. Relevance grades were manually authored by mapping ACBP course titles to KCM competencies based on domain keywords and cadre seniority. These labels DO NOT represent independent external SME adjudication, empirical field trials, or real-world learner evaluations.
methodology_and_construction: Each scenario defines a synthetic learner profile representing a standard MoSPI cadre (e.g., Director, SSS JSO, ISS STS, Administrative Officer) with 2-3 target competency gaps. Ground truth relevances (0-3) were graded based on: Grade 3 (exact competency and cadre match), Grade 2 (aligned competency across adjacent cadre or strong domain utility), Grade 1 (category match only), Grade 0 (unrelated domain or cadre mismatch).
assumptions_and_limitations: Evaluated exclusively against the static 226-course MoSPI ACBP FY 2026-27 catalogue.
Relevance grades reflect offline topical relevance rather than empirical learning efficacy or post-training assessment gains.
No statistical significance testing is claimed given the small sample size (N=10 scenarios).
Local latency metrics measure CPU execution time of in-memory ranking functions and do not account for database transactions or HTTP network round-trips.
warning: SYNTHETIC/CURATED OFFLINE BENCHMARK ONLY. NOT TESTED ON LIVE GOVERNMENT LEARNERS.
